full_judgment: 4. The case of defendant Nos. 1-10, inter alia, is that Ka schedule land along with other land originally belonged to Abhoy Chandra and Janaki in equal shares. By a registered patta dated 3-4-43, one Profulla took settlement of the property of khatian No. 34 of Ka schedule along with other land which was subsequently inherited by the nephews of Profulla. Janoki's brother Puma settled 2.74 acres of land to Sudhir on 17-12-1940. But subsequently in 1943 Sudhir sold the same to Jogesh and others, and defendant Nos. 3 and 4 got the same by purchase in 1945. Defendant Nos. 5-7 inherited the land of plot No. 197. Defendant No. 4 by a registered patta dated 7-9-43 took settlement of 2.03 acres of land from Krishna and Bishnu, the successive heirs of Janaki. Defendant No. 1 took settlement of 0.33 acres of land of plot Nos. 197 and 214 by a registered patta dated 12-1-1950. According to those defendants, they had never been the borgadars of the plaintiffs and the plaintiffs story of getting possession of the suit land in pursuance of the orders passed in pre-emption cases is false and concocted.
